column1: # IP address to integration dataset mapping for source-IP-based routing.
# The value must be a valid data_stream dataset name (e.g. cisco_ftd.log).
# Unmatched source IPs are sent to the generic syslog data stream.
# The 127.0.1.x entries are convenient loopback test addresses. On Linux
# any 127.x.x.x address can be bound without OS-level configuration
# they work with logsim's --bind option when Logstash is running directly on
# the host. When Logstash is inside Docker with port forwarding
# is rewritten to the Docker gateway address (e.g. 172.18.0.1); in that case
# run the senders in the same Docker network instead.
